name: Rezon
overview: Rezon is a male figure in the Bible known primarily as an adversary to King Solomon. The Scriptures do not specify his tribal affiliation or other personal details beyond his opposition to Solomon's reign. His role highlights the challenges faced by Solomon during his kingship.
namesAndTitles: The name Rezon means 'prince' or 'high official,' reflecting a position of authority or leadership. This proper name is noted in 1 Kings 11:23 and is not indicated to be given by God.
familyAndRelationships: Rezon is identified as the son of Eliada according to 1 Kings 11:23. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not record any additional family connections for Rezon.
scriptureSignificance: Rezon's significance lies in his role as an adversary to Solomon, representing opposition during Solomon's reign. His presence in the biblical narrative underscores the internal and external challenges that Solomon faced as king. This opposition contributes to the broader understanding of the political and spiritual dynamics in Israel during Solomon's time.
